description: Given a set of MCP servers and their tool counts, show for every model context window (128K, 200K, 1M, 10M) how much of the window the tool definitions consume, how much is left for conversation, and whether the server set fits at all. Answers "how many servers can I attach on model X?".

avgTokensPerTool.description: Default tokens per tool definition when a server omits it (default 550)

conversationShare.description: Fraction of the window you want left for human/agent conversation, 0-1 (default 0.25)

reserveForOutput.description: Tokens to reserve for the model response (default 8000)

servers.description: JSON array of {name, toolCount, avgTokensPerTool?} — e.g. [{"name":"github","toolCount":35}]. Accepts a JSON array, or a JSON string containing one.

name: plan_context_window_budget
